newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer in talks to buy Occidental plant.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer in talks to buy Occidental plant.

text.p: Pioneer Cos Inc said Wednesday it reached a preliminary understanding with Occidental Petroleum Corp over terms for Pioneer's proposed purchase of Occidental's chlor-alkali facility in Washington.
Pioneer said it expected a definitive agreement and the securing of required financing would be completed during the first quarter of 1997.
Terms of the understanding were not disclosed.

Richard Kellogg, Pioneer's president and chief executive officer, said the plant had an annual production capacity of about 225,000 tons of chlorine and 250,000 tons of caustic soda and would be Pioneer's largest.
